mentions.name: Agent OS
mentions.description: A WASM- and V8 isolate-based operating system that is (almost) POSIX-compliant, with its own network stack, VFS, and process tree. It allows compiling most C or Rust programs to run in it without modification and can run coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and OpenCode unmodified. Currently being polished with a focus on security and documentation ahead of a deep-dive writeup.
